title: Sentinel Settings
description: Schema for settings.json that configures Sentinel sweep behavior including risk policy, browser settings, breakpoints, and report output.

riskPolicy.description: Controls which actions are executed based on risk level.

maxRiskLevel.description: Maximum risk level that will be executed without sandbox approval.

alwaysSkip.description: List of METHOD /path patterns to always skip regardless of risk level.

alwaysAllow.description: List of METHOD /path patterns to always allow regardless of risk level.

breakpoints.description: Viewport widths in pixels for responsive layout testing.

responseTimeout.description: Maximum response time in milliseconds before a request is considered slow.

screenshotOnError.description: Whether to capture screenshots when errors are detected during browser sweeps.

reportDir.description: Base output directory for sweep reports and run directories.

browserType.description: Browser engine to use for sweeps.

credentialsSource.description: Source of test credentials. Typically 'manifest' to read from sentinel-manifest.json.

emptyContainerSelectors.description: CSS selectors for containers that should be checked for empty content during browser sweeps.
